_doc: The org-wide lane (CLOSED-LOOP-AXIOM). One queue, one merge lane, one drift loop across every repository. Read by foundation/fleet.py. Surfaces are tried in order per repository; the first that can write is used and recorded in ops/fleet-log.jsonl.

surfaces.how: LANE_PAT secret already used by executor.yml
a cloud-hosted Claude routine with the GitHub connector (deploy/loops/claude-routine.md); it runs on Anthropic's servers, never on a person's computer

require: checks green or no checks defined
merge._doc: Rowan 2026-11-12: merge PRs immediately, never wait on a PR, resolve all PRs and issues automatically. Checks and the interrupt gate still apply.

copies._doc: REPO-CONFORM-2: Citation File Format 1.2.0 takes only an SPDX licence list id in `license`; a LicenseRef licence is named by `license-url` (seed/scripts/surfaces.py renders it, seed/scripts/repoconform.py validates it).

dependencies.open: Spec change in {from}: verify status labels in {to} (tools/spec_truth.py)
